channels.reason: Chin EMG bipolar pair with a 10-80 Hz filter; it showed an EMG-like trace in one recording.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with a sound transducer, used as the snore channel.

channels.label: Flusso
channels.reason: Italian 'flusso' (flow) with a pressure transducer, so it is nasal pressure; flat in one recording.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian 'torace' is thoracic effort; respiratory trace in both recordings.

channels.label: ADDDOME
channels.reason: Misspelled Italian 'addome' is abdominal effort; respiratory trace in one recording.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: Italian 'sinistra' (SX) EMG pair with a 10-80 Hz filter and EMG trace, so left leg EMG.

channels.label: DX1_DX2
channels.reason: Italian 'destra' (DX) EMG pair with a 10 Hz high-pass, so right leg EMG; EMG trace in one recording.

channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Body position channel; flat in both recordings, which can be normal if the patient did not change position.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Oximeter pulse waveform (Pwave transducer); pleth trace in one recording.
